title: US Coast Guard monitors Western Maui Wildfires Emergency Support Function #10 response operation to removal sunken vessel from Lahaina Harbor, Hawaii
description: Contracted personnel tow a nearby sunken vessel into Lahaina Habor, Hawaii, after refloating it with lift bags, Nov. 1, 2023. The Unified Command, comprised of the U.S. Coast Guard, Hawaii Department of Land and Natural Resources, and Hawaii Department of Health, contracted Global Diving and Salvage to conduct salvage and recovery operations at Lahaina Harbor in support of Western Maui Wildfires Emergency Support Function #10. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Brandon Hillard)
keywords: Coast Guard District 14, Lahaina, ESF 10, Maui Wildfires, Hawaii Wildfires 2023, Coast Guard
